Our Story

Crafted with
Tradition & Love

Named after the sacred Chandrabhaga river of Pandharpur, Rokade's is a testament to purity and heritage. Every product carries the warmth of a Maharashtrian home kitchen.

We source milk exclusively from healthy desi cows raised on natural feed — no shortcuts, no chemicals, just honest dairy made the way it has been for generations.
